title: When to Align, When to Predict: A Phase Diagram for Multimodal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.11190v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cross-modal alignment (CA) and cross-modal prediction (CP) are the dominant paradigms for multimodal representation learning, yet there is no systematic understanding of when each succeeds and when each fails --- a gap that leaves practitioners, especially in scientific domains with heterogeneous instruments and multiple levels of measurement, unable to diagnose why standard methods underperform the best single modality. We study both objectives under a spiked signal-plus-noise model with structured cross-modal nuisance correlation, the ingredient that breaks the classical recovery guarantees, and derive separation ratios that expose complementary failure modes: alignment whitens each modality and fails when nuisance is strongly correlated across views; prediction encodes whatever is cross-predictable through a one-sided whitening, with recovery governed by source-modality quality. translated_title: 何时对齐，何时预测：多模态学习的相图
translated_abstract: 跨模态对齐（CA）和跨模态预测（CP）是多模态表征学习的两大主流范式，然而对于两者何时成功、何时失败，目前缺乏系统性的理解——这一空白使得实践者，尤其是在拥有异构仪器和多层次测量的科学领域中的从业者，无法诊断为什么标准方法的表现不如最佳单一模态。我们在具有结构化跨模态噪声相关性的尖峰信号加噪声模型下研究这两种目标，这种噪声相关性正是打破经典恢复保证的关键因素，并推导出了揭示互补失败模式的分离比率：对齐方法会对每个模态进行白化处理，当噪声在视图间强相关时会失败；预测方法通过单侧白化编码所有可跨模态预测的信息，其恢复效果由源模态的质量决定。由此得到的相图将多模态问题划分为不同区域。
tldr: 本文通过带结构化跨模态噪声相关的尖峰信号加噪声模型，揭示了跨模态对齐与跨模态预测两种范式的互补失败模式，并构建相图为多模态学习中范式的选择提供了理论指导。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the complementary failure modes of cross-modal alignment and cross-modal prediction under a spiked signal-plus-noise model with structured nuisance correlation, and constructs a phase diagram providing theoretical guidance for paradigm selection in multimodal learning.
